description: Delete a stored recipient from your account directory. The record is kept with its personal data removed (email, name, phone, metadata and any stored signature), so later reads return 404 and a new envelope to the same address creates a fresh recipient; envelopes already sent keep their own copy and are not affected. Rejected with a 400 error while the recipient has an active stored signature or a pending enrolment — call remove_recipient_signature first.
name: delete_recipient
